**What this changes and why:**

**Tested on:** which OS, GPU and Horizon build?

- [ ] Shader: `tools/check-shader.sh` prints `OK`
- [ ] Visual change: a screenshot (`tools/capture.py`) or a short clip of the moment it affects
- [ ] Driver: a full strike in a throwaway world, with an empty chat and a shaft to bedrock (or say what you couldn't test)
- [ ] Sounds: all eight listened to in game, if you touched them
- [ ] No Minecraft assets, no decompiled code, and any third-party material is in `NOTICE` (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
